capfood.list.title: CONFIGURABLE FOODS
capfood.food.description: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef.
capfood.food.cooked_cod.lore: This silver fish was fall before Excalibur and now serve Knight King, the correct treasure of all seven ocean kingdom today.
capfood.food.cooked_porkchop.lore: One crimson beast got defeated by royal fire; the porkchop now make Knight King strong for his next very grand crusade now.
capfood.food.cooked_mutton.lore: The plains ram challenged crown and losed; his roasted power now fuel the unstoppable marching of the whole big kingdom.
capfood.food.cooked_rabbit.lore: Not even speed of lunar beast escaped royal judging; now his rare flavor belong in the mighty table of the truth king today.
capfood.food.cooked_chicken.lore: Golden bird gived all strength to kingdom after facing Excalibur, making one feast very worthy of every knight travel now.
capfood.food.cooked_salmon.lore: Scarlet dragon of river was mastered by sacred fire and now give all energy for sovereign commander of the currents forever.
capfood.food.mushroom_stew.lore: Mushrooms from enchanted forest was sealed in this royal cauldron, becoming nutrition potion of very absolute power forever.
capfood.food.rabbit_stew.lore: Royal alchemy united lunar beast with roots and fungi inside broth, the supremest fuel for next kingdom campaign of destiny.
capfood.food.suspicious_stew.lore: Only truth king drink this elixir without fearing the hidden magic; destiny will decide what power is awaken inside today.
capfood.food.beetroot_soup.lore: This crimson broth contain symbolic blood of earth, summoned for make Knight King stronger during his royal campaign now.
capfood.food.baked_potato.lore: Underground jewel got purified in royal flames; below toasted armor is resting one strength very worthy of crown forever.
capfood.food.cookie.lore: Small royal stamp maked with far cocoa; even the littlest relic can restore much power of one hungry noble knight today.
capfood.food.cake.lore: This monument of sugar celebrate coronation what world not accepted yet; every slice confirm the most rightful claim now.
capfood.food.honey_bottle.lore: Thousand bee alchemists distilled sun light inside bottle, one golden elixir reserved to Knight King and royal court now.
capfood.food.apple.lore: Picked from sacred tree of kingdom, this apple carry one crunchy oath for restore the force of the truth sovereign forever.
capfood.food.bread.lore: Common wheat reborned as royal provision in flames; no knight can marching without this strong shield against the hunger.
capfood.food.pumpkin_pie.lore: Orange moon got captured inside sacred pastry; every slice give Knight King the secret power from very great harvest now.
capfood.food.glow_berries.lore: Underground stars ripened in these berries; their glowing feed the sovereign who cross every abyss without hesitating now.
capfood.food.sweet_berries.lore: Thorns guarded these red jewels, but no natural wall can resist the very triumphant harvesting of the truth Knight King.
capfood.food.popped_chorus_fruit.lore: Dimensional fruit got conquered by fire of Excalibur; now its power guide the king in paths what ignore all the space today.
capfood.food.popped_chorus_fruit.descrip: Applies the same nutritional values as Cooked Beef. Also unlocks the Smoker recipe that turns 1 Chorus Fruit into 1 Popped Chorus Fruit in 100 ticks (5 seconds), granting 0.1 experience.
capfood.food.dried_kelp.lore: Rised from deep and sealed by heat, this ocean blade lend mighty power of tides directly for the truth Knight King forever.
capfood.action.toggle_all.tooltip: Toggle between selecting and deselecting all.
capfood.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
capfood.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
capfood.options.consume_container.lore: Knight King leave no empty relic behind: bowls and bottles also surrender complete for the absolute appetite of crown today.
capfood.options.consume_container.descri: Also consumes stew bowls, honey bottles and drinkable potion bottles.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.lor: Eyes of sovereign judge every banquet before bite, revealing nutrition, vigor and time like secret things of kingdom forever.
capfood.options.show_food_properties.des: Shows hunger, saturation and consumption time while holding Shift over a compatible food or the reference Cooked Beef. For Suspicious Stew, it lists every possible effect without revealing which effect the item contains.
Sigil of Excalibur expose every relic with hidden knowing, because no secret resist the powerful eyes of truth Knight King.
Adds an asterisk to the end of the name of every item with information shown only while holding Shift, including content from Minecraft and other mods.
capfood.options.prevent_rotten_flesh_wol: Wolves from royal guard never will touch corrupted meat; the loyalty deserve foods worthy for protectors of the crown today.
Prevents feeding wolves with Rotten Flesh.
capfood.options.prevent_primary_food_con: No sacred ingredient will be devoured before complete the culinary mission inside kingdom forges and royal cauldrons ever.
Prevents consuming these 12 primary foods: Beetroot, Carrot, Potato, Raw Beef, Raw Chicken, Raw Mutton, Raw Porkchop, Raw Rabbit, Pufferfish, Raw Cod, Raw Salmon and Tropical Fish.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.lor: Mount of Knight King know leaves is small illusions and cross the forest with one charge worthy of the biggest legend now.
capfood.options.horse_ignores_leaves.des: Removes leaf collision for horse-family mounts while controlled by a player.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.lore: When sovereign trunk fall, the army of leaves receive royal ordering for abandon all forest skies very immediately today.
capfood.options.faster_leaf_decay.descri: After cutting the last connected log of a natural Overworld tree, assigned leaves disappear 20× faster than vanilla. Touching canopies estimate leaf origin by log proximity. Remaining leaves disappear together after 5 seconds.
capfood.options.increased_sapling_bee_ne: Flowers near announce lands gived by crown; bees is arriving for build one golden colony inside the young growing kingdom.

Increases from 5% to 20% the chance for oak, birch and cherry trees grown from saplings to generate with a bee nest containing 2–3 bees when a flower is within 2 blocks horizontally and 1 block vertically of the sapling.
capfood.options.bees_survive_stinging.lo: Golden warriors not fall after using the stinger; by decree royal, they continues alive for defending sacred beehive today.
capfood.options.bees_survive_stinging.de: Prevents bees from dying after stinging. The sting retains its vanilla damage and poison.
capfood.options.show_status_effect_panel: Royal vision make every blessing and cursing visible in battlefield; no aura can hiding its power away from the king forever.

Shows a panel in the HUD's top-right corner with the icon, name, level and remaining duration of each active effect, following the inventory panel's appearance and ordering. Names wider than Night Vision are abbreviated. Hides the inventory effect panel.
capfood.options.show_potion_recipes.lore: Grimoire of kingdom reveal every evolution from Awkward Potion, because alchemy also bow to wisdom of the Knight King now.
capfood.options.show_potion_recipes.desc: While holding Shift, shows the compatible ingredients for each potion brewed directly from an Awkward Potion: its brewing ingredient, Redstone for extended duration, Gunpowder for the splash form and Glowstone Dust for potency, when available.
capfood.status.applied: CAP applied to the selected foods.
